name: Bounded HRA liver-spleen LFS pilot
on:
  push:
    branches:
      - cloud/liver-spleen-lfs-pilot-20261023
    paths:
      - .github/workflows/liver-spleen-lfs-pilot.yml
permissions: {}
jobs:
  upload-and-verify:
    if: github.repository == 'qianyizhang/med-assets' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/cloud/liver-spleen-lfs-pilot-20261023'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    permissions:
      contents: write
    env:
      GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT: '0'
      APPROVED_MANIFEST: >-
        {"objects":[{"oid":"e9abb0c2503a3fa9d725988451e630283ec2c902c182b812219f2d73f3ab1038","size":763480,"url":"https://anatomy-verification.landy123007.chatgpt.site/review/candidates/liver__hra-female-exterior-r02/e9abb0c2503a3fa9d725988451e630283ec2c902c182b812219f2d73f3ab1038.glb.gz","type":"glb","file":"models/liver/exports/hra-female-v1.10-r02/liver.glb","encoding":"gzip","transportSize":617339,"transportOid":"260c0d78cc2c20de34f5cb5cb2efb57cb587383b6e2ce8309d8626134b3b314d"},{"oid":"95dc1fbe004091bc9940a4a0b912dcd0160077053392c7d81bd9822571602f8a","size":11170,"url":"https://anatomy-verification.landy123007.chatgpt.site/review/evidence/canonical/liver__hra-female-exterior-r02__scoped-review/1e3440d5b8f0f3f481451d4e846f7c8d24c80d5c6b60f56ffa23eff4a7e6aeeb.webp","type":"webp","file":"reviews/liver/2026-10-23-hra-female-v1.10-r02/display/candidate_material_oblique.webp"},{"oid":"f694e03476862fc2482690244055a75a5cc27e0d39565e16ae148f28841246a2","size":64202,"url":"https://anatomy-verification.landy123007.chatgpt.site/review/evidence/canonical/liver__hra-female-exterior-r02__scoped-review/fec31ad4e6abc5d5d5c749b043a6d1f6a0197a84bf344853ee8ea5b411008513.webp","type":"webp","file":"reviews/liver/2026-10-23-hra-female-v1.10-r02/display/contact.webp"},{"oid":"4e2637cf6c844aef85ab77c2c1049d4e7647348a13c34d784795b98825f7c8c7","size":278576,"url":"https://anatomy-verification.landy123007.chatgpt.site/review/candidates/spleen__hra-female-r03/4e2637cf6c844aef85ab77c2c1049d4e7647348a13c34d784795b98825f7c8c7.glb.gz","type":"glb","file":"models/spleen/exports/hra-female-v1.10-r03/spleen.glb","encoding":"gzip","transportSize":219888,"transportOid":"394995cd76c086b23cd63d94aacdc3f424da533933003b779a7028e12c7052bf"},{"oid":"94dabf0d88d80fba0731083cdcfbbe95e2acbbdbc445a01cdc5db1a7c3ca7202","size":10750,"url":"https://anatomy-verification.landy123007.chatgpt.site/review/evidence/canonical/spleen__hra-female-r03__scoped-review/d5a5ebf4793e0a1c55789710f6dd548d8a2edf37ad969fd1fab1af6becadffd9.webp","type":"webp","file":"reviews/spleen/2026-10-23-hra-female-v1.10-r03/display/candidate_material_oblique.webp"},{"oid":"eeb2d439c11c0757f764e9380eabfabd58cd2387cbba9d6ed60ef54eeb6bcf3f","size":53174,"url":"https://anatomy-verification.landy123007.chatgpt.site/review/evidence/canonical/spleen__hra-female-r03__scoped-review/dc78a16000cebe9bd1b78a5171cadf1e19e2318fdc9d7aa4a13c2ec96d93ea7f.webp","type":"webp","file":"reviews/spleen/2026-10-23-hra-female-v1.10-r03/display/contact.webp"}]}
    steps:
      - name: Configure temporary repository authentication
        uses: actions/checkout@d23441a48e516b6c34aea4fa41551a30e30af803
        with:
          fetch-depth: 1
          lfs: false
          submodules: false
          sparse-checkout: .gitattributes
          sparse-checkout-cone-mode: false
          persist-credentials: true
          show-progress: false
      - name: Verify sources, upload only six exact OIDs, and independently read back
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          python3 - <<'PY'
          import gzip, hashlib, io, json, os, pathlib, re, subprocess, urllib.parse, urllib.request
          
          manifest = json.loads(os.environ["APPROVED_MANIFEST"])
          objects = manifest["objects"]
          assert len(objects) == 6 and len({o["oid"] for o in objects}) == 6, "Unexpected object count"
          assert sum(o["size"] for o in objects) == 1181352, "Unexpected total bytes"
          assert sum(o["size"] for o in objects) <= 1181352, "Approved batch cap exceeded"
          assert max(o["size"] for o in objects) <= 763480, "Per-object limit exceeded"
          assert all(re.fullmatch("[0-9a-f]{64}", o["oid"]) and 0 < o["size"] <= 763480 for o in objects), "Invalid object constraints"
          work = pathlib.Path(os.environ["RUNNER_TEMP"], "liver-spleen-approved-pilot")
          work.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
          
          # Every source is public. Do not read or pass GitHub credentials to source URLs.
          for o in objects:
              parsed = urllib.parse.urlsplit(o["url"])
              assert parsed.scheme == "https" and parsed.hostname in {"cdn.humanatlas.io", "anatomy-verification.landy123007.chatgpt.site"}, "Unapproved source host"
              assert parsed.username is None and parsed.password is None, "Credentials in URL refused"
              encoding = o.get("encoding", "identity")
              assert encoding in {"identity", "gzip"}, "Unapproved source encoding"
              transfer_size = o.get("transportSize", o["size"])
              transfer_oid = o.get("transportOid", o["oid"])
              assert 0 < transfer_size <= 763480 and re.fullmatch("[0-9a-f]{64}", transfer_oid), "Invalid transport constraints"
              if encoding == "gzip":
                  assert "transportSize" in o and "transportOid" in o, "Gzip transport manifest required"
              else:
                  assert transfer_size == o["size"] and transfer_oid == o["oid"], "Identity transport mismatch"
              req = urllib.request.Request(o["url"], headers={"User-Agent": "med-assets-liver-spleen-pilot/1.0", "Accept-Encoding": "identity"})
              with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=45) as response:
                  assert urllib.parse.urlsplit(response.url).scheme == "https", "Non-HTTPS redirect refused"
                  transport = response.read(transfer_size + 1)
              assert len(transport) == transfer_size and hashlib.sha256(transport).hexdigest() == transfer_oid, "Transport size or SHA-256 mismatch"
              if encoding == "gzip":
                  with gzip.GzipFile(fileobj=io.BytesIO(transport)) as compressed:
                      data = compressed.read(o["size"] + 1)
              else:
                  data = transport
              assert len(data) == o["size"], "Source size mismatch"
              assert hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest() == o["oid"], "Source SHA-256 mismatch"
              if o["type"] == "glb":
                  assert data[:4] == b"glTF", "Source is not GLB"
              elif o["type"] == "webp":
                  assert data[:4] == b"RIFF" and data[8:12] == b"WEBP", "Source is not WebP"
              else:
                  raise AssertionError("Unapproved content type")
              (work / o["oid"]).write_bytes(data)
              print(f"SOURCE VERIFIED {o['oid']} {o['size']} bytes", flush=True)
          
          subprocess.run(["git", "lfs", "version"], check=True)
          subprocess.run(["git", "lfs", "install", "--local"], check=True)
          # Validate every LFS pointer before uploading any object.
          for o in objects:
              with (work / o["oid"]).open("rb") as source:
                  clean = subprocess.run(["git", "lfs", "clean", "approved-" + o["oid"]], stdin=source, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, check=True)
              expected = f"version https://git-lfs.github.com/spec/v1\noid sha256:{o['oid']}\nsize {o['size']}\n".encode()
              assert clean.stdout == expected, "Generated LFS pointer mismatch"
          for o in objects:
              subprocess.run(["git", "lfs", "push", "--object-id", "origin", o["oid"]], check=True)
              print(f"UPLOAD COMMAND PASSED {o['oid']} {o['size']} bytes", flush=True)
          
          # Independent HTTP readback, without the local LFS cache or GitHub user credentials.
          endpoint = "https://github.com/qianyizhang/med-assets.git/info/lfs/objects/batch"
          payload = json.dumps({"operation": "download", "transfers": ["basic"], "objects": [{"oid": o["oid"], "size": o["size"]} for o in objects]}).encode()
          headers = {"Accept": "application/vnd.git-lfs+json", "Content-Type": "application/vnd.git-lfs+json", "User-Agent": "med-assets-liver-spleen-pilot-readback/1.0"}
          with urllib.request.urlopen(urllib.request.Request(endpoint, data=payload, headers=headers), timeout=45) as response:
              result = json.load(response)
          returned = {o["oid"]: o for o in result.get("objects", [])}
          assert set(returned) == {o["oid"] for o in objects}, "Unexpected LFS Batch objects"
          for expected in objects:
              obj = returned[expected["oid"]]
              assert obj.get("size") == expected["size"] and "error" not in obj, "GitHub object unavailable"
              action = obj.get("actions", {}).get("download")
              assert action and urllib.parse.urlsplit(action["href"]).scheme == "https", "Invalid LFS download action"
              req = urllib.request.Request(action["href"], headers=action.get("header", {}))
              with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=45) as response:
                  assert urllib.parse.urlsplit(response.url).scheme == "https", "Non-HTTPS LFS redirect refused"
                  data = response.read(expected["size"] + 1)
              assert len(data) == expected["size"] and hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest() == expected["oid"], "GitHub LFS readback mismatch"
              print(f"GITHUB READBACK VERIFIED {expected['oid']} {len(data)} bytes", flush=True)
          print("PASS: 6 exact objects; 1181352 bytes; no Git asset pointer or branch-tip commit pushed by this job.", flush=True)
          PY
